arguments.content:
import pandas as pd

path = "budget.xlsx"
xls = pd.ExcelFile(path)
print("Sheets:", xls.sheet_names)
for name in xls.sheet_names:
    df = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=name, header=None)
    print(f"\n=== Sheet: {name} shape={df.shape} ===")
    print(df.to_string(max_rows=60))

from openpyxl import load_workbook

wb = load_workbook("budget.xlsx", data_only=False)
ws = wb["Budget"]
print("Total Income row:", ws["B8"].value, "| formula cell B8:", ws["B8"].value)
print("Total Expenses row:", ws["B23"].value, "| amount cell C23:", repr(ws["C23"].value))
print("BALANCE row:", ws["B25"].value, "| amount cell C25:", repr(ws["C25"].value))

# Check expense rows content
for r in range(11, 23):
    print(r, [ws.cell(row=r, column=c).value for c in range(1, 4)])

wb2 = load_workbook("budget.xlsx", data_only=True)
ws2 = wb2["Budget"]
print("Cached values -> C8:", repr(ws2["C8"].value), "C23:", repr(ws2["C23"].value), "C25:", repr(ws2["C25"].value))
